dict.string: When you are close to a friend who allowed you to trace them, the camera helps work out which way they are. It only tracks how your phone moves: nothing is recorded, saved or sent.
ThatWay uses Face ID to check it is really you before it lets a friend see where you are.
Precise Location lets ThatWay point the compass and call out turns at the right moment. It is only used while you are using the app or guiding a trip.
